limitations: Metadata and IL facts only; no game code executed and no native implementation analyzed.
Raw-pointer candidates are same-method read/store co-occurrence; they are not proven writes to Grid.
Does not prove absence of aliased pointer writes, array/cache writes, native writers or calls in other assemblies.
Indirect calls, delegate/reflection dispatch, generated runtime code and other mods need separate review.
Member references with unresolved generic TypeSpec parents are reported, not silently considered safe.

observedEvidence.comparison: element hash/T/mass exact float32 against actual Start snapshot; radiation/disease/backwall mass/temperature all zero in this test

limitations: Not a supported public Klei save API; reject any unrecognized version/dimensions/length/hash.
Padding and placement must be validated for every cluster world, including guard cells.
Native Load applies load-time phase transitions; filtered native definitions must precede Load.
Nonzero radiation/disease/backwalls and multiworld offsets need dedicated roundtrip tests.
Sanitized native load passed the isolated synthetic Windows process test; full Unity colony takeover remains unproved.

importHookOrder.stageAllWorlds: Cluster.LoadClusterSim(List<Klei.SimSaveFileStructure>, FastReader) : void postfix while new-colony scope active
importHookOrder.warning: LoadClusterSim catches deserialization exceptions; validate returned count and every record against Cluster.worlds.
importHookOrder.wrappedPayload: SimSaveFileStructure.Sim contains int32 native payload length followed by raw native save; Split takes raw save only.
importHookOrder.ordinarySavePath: SaveLoader.Load -> Sim.LoadWorld; deliberately separate from new-colony import
transactionLimitations: Stage all raw payloads, hash mappings, placed interiors, custom inventory requirements and clones before replacing any item.Sim or calling native initialization.
Validate outer lengths, world dimensions/placement/count and whole-cluster nonoverlap; imported backwall/guard fluids must reject.
Atomically publish staged clones only after all parse/validation succeeds; keep original buffers and ledgers until native load/Start verification commits.
First-frame projection, component handles, failed native load cleanup and save rollback still require a real colony adapter.
Static direct-call absence does not cover reflection, other managed assemblies or installed mods.

remainingFluidSourceCategories.nativeCells: load-time/cell transitions, byproducts, sublimation/conversion and element interactions; only synthetic ice/empty shadow controls have passed
remainingFluidSourceCategories.nativeRegistries: consumer/emitter registration, including BuildingElementEmitter and GeothermalVent; native emitter pressure/blocking assumes native fluid mass
remainingFluidSourceCategories.chunks: SimTemperatureTransfer.SimRegister does not restrict phase; native thermal chunk melt notice invokes managed original-element transitions
remainingFluidSourceCategories.backwalls: native transition notice + BackwallManager.UpdateFromSim chooses original managed targets/byproducts and sends SetBackwallData/AddRemoveSubstance
remainingFluidSourceCategories.buildings: native heat/melt notice + StructureTemperatureComponents.DoMelt emits fluid then destroys building; self/exhaust heat must couple transactionally
remainingFluidSourceCategories.converters: ElementConverter.ConvertMass consumes storage mass/disease and calls onConvertMass before output; stored gas/liquid outputs bypass world-cell ingress
remainingFluidSourceCategories.conduits: single-element packet thermal phase events, dumps, consumers and vents; fluid item and storage state must be owned
remainingFluidSourceCategories.particlesAndBiology: FallingWater, BubbleManager, geysers, Sublimates, metabolism/excreta, creatures and crop emitters
remainingFluidSourceCategories.cellPlacementAndExternalEvents: templates/sandbox, doors/occupiers displacement, construction/digging, meteor/rocket/reaction events
remainingFluidSourceCategories.coverageStatus: inventory of observed paths and native categories; not a completeness proof or implemented ownership.
